desc: Derive that f(L,R) is the number of contiguous value-runs in the distinct-value set, and that appending a new value x changes the run count by 1 - I(x-1 present) - I(x+1 present) for subarrays where x was absent.
Implement the O(N) right-end sweep in Python using last occurrences, current ending-sum cur, total ans, and boundary-safe last[x-1]/last[x+1].
Test the implementation on the provided samples and edge cases; all public samples passed.
